title: What “Liquidity” Means in a Market
summary: Liquidity is how easily an asset can be bought or sold without moving its price much. A liquid market has many buyers and sellers close together in price.
blocks: Liquidity is how easily an asset can be bought or sold without moving its price much. A liquid market has many buyers and sellers close together in price.
In a thin, illiquid market the gap between the best buy and sell prices widens, and even modest orders can push the price noticeably.
Liquidity is why large, widely traded coins tend to have steadier quoted prices than small ones — there is simply more depth on both sides.
